verses.1:1: And the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying,
verses.1:2: "Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, 'When any man among you presents an offering to the LORD, from the livestock—from the herd and from the flock—you shall present your offering.
verses.1:3: If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall present a male without blemish; at the entrance of the tent of meeting he shall present it, for his acceptance before the LORD.
verses.1:4: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.
verses.1:5: Then he shall slaughter the young bull before the LORD; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall present the blood and dash the blood all around against the altar that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.1:6: Then he shall skin the burnt offering and divide it into its pieces.
verses.1:7: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar and arrange wood in order upon the fire.
verses.1:8: Then the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall arrange the pieces, the head, and the fat upon the wood that is on the fire upon the altar;
verses.1:9: but its entrails and its legs he shall wash with water. And the priest shall burn all of it on the altar—a burnt offering, an offering by fire of a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.1:10: And if his offering is from the flock—from the sheep or from the goats—for a burnt offering, he shall present a male without blemish.
verses.1:11: He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before the LORD; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall dash its blood all around against the altar.
verses.1:12: And he shall cut it into its pieces, along with its head and its fat, and the priest shall arrange them upon the wood that is on the fire upon the altar;
verses.1:13: but the entrails and the legs he shall wash with water. And the priest shall present all of it and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.1:14: And if his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall present his offering from the turtledoves or from the young pigeons.
verses.1:15: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out against the wall of the altar.
verses.1:16: And he shall remove its crop with its feathers and cast it beside the altar on the east side, at the place of the ashes.
verses.1:17: Then he shall tear it open by its wings, but shall not divide it completely; and the priest shall burn it on the altar, upon the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of a pleasing aroma to the LORD.'"
verses.2:1: Now when any person presents a grain offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it and put frankincense upon it.
verses.2:2: He shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and one of them shall take from it a full handful of its fine flour and of its oil, together with all its frankincense; and the priest shall burn its memorial portion on the altar, an offering by fire of a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.2:3: And the remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and to his sons; it is most holy among the offerings by fire to the LORD.
verses.2:4: And when you present a grain offering baked in an oven, it shall be of fine flour—unleavened cakes mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.2:5: And if your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle, it shall be of fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened.
verses.2:6: You shall break it into pieces and pour oil upon it; it is a grain offering.
verses.2:7: And if your offering is a grain offering prepared in a deep pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.2:8: And you shall bring to the LORD the grain offering that is made of these things; it shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it near to the altar.
verses.2:9: Then the priest shall take up from the grain offering its memorial portion and burn it on the altar, an offering by fire of a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.2:10: And the remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and to his sons; it is most holy among the offerings by fire to the LORD.
verses.2:11: No grain offering that you present to the LORD shall be made with leaven, for you shall burn neither any leaven nor any honey as an offering by fire to the LORD.
verses.2:12: As an offering of firstfruits you may present them to the LORD, yet they shall not ascend upon the altar for a pleasing aroma.
verses.2:13: And every grain offering of yours you shall season with salt; you shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your grain offering. With every offering of yours you shall present salt.
verses.2:14: And if you present a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, you shall present fresh heads of grain parched with fire, crushed grain of the new harvest, as the grain offering of your firstfruits.
verses.2:15: And you shall put oil upon it and lay frankincense upon it; it is a grain offering.
verses.2:16: Then the priest shall burn its memorial portion—part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, together with all its frankincense—as an offering by fire to the LORD.
verses.3:1: Now if his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he presents it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall present it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.3:2: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall dash the blood all around against the altar.
verses.3:3: Then he shall present from the sacrifice of the peace offerings, as an offering by fire to the LORD, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is upon the entrails,
verses.3:4: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the loins, and the lobe upon the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
verses.3:5: And the sons of Aaron shall burn it on the altar, upon the burnt offering that is on the wood upon the fire; it is an offering by fire of a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.3:6: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, male or female, he shall present it without blemish.
verses.3:7: If he presents a lamb as his offering, then he shall present it before the LORD.
verses.3:8: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering and slaughter it before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall dash its blood all around against the altar.
verses.3:9: Then he shall present from the sacrifice of the peace offerings, as an offering by fire to the LORD, its fat—the entire fat tail, which he shall remove close to the backbone—and the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is upon the entrails,
verses.3:10: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the loins, and the lobe upon the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
verses.3:11: And the priest shall burn it on the altar as food, an offering by fire to the LORD.
verses.3:12: And if his offering is a goat, then he shall present it before the LORD.
verses.3:13: And he shall lay his hand upon its head and slaughter it before the tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall dash its blood all around against the altar.
verses.3:14: Then he shall present from it his offering, as an offering by fire to the LORD, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is upon the entrails,
verses.3:15: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the loins, and the lobe upon the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
verses.3:16: And the priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering by fire for a pleasing aroma. All fat belongs to the LORD.
verses.3:17: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations, in all your dwellings: you shall not eat any fat or any blood.
verses.4:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.4:2: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'If a person sins unintentionally against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and does any one of them:
verses.4:3: If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt upon the people, then he shall offer to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without blemish as a sin offering.
verses.4:4: And he shall bring the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting before the LORD, and lay his hand upon the head of the bull, and slay the bull before the LORD.
verses.4:5: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull and bring it to the tent of meeting.
verses.4:6: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.4:7: And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before the LORD, which is in the tent of meeting; and all the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.4:8: And he shall lift off from it all the fat of the bull of the sin offering: the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is upon the inward parts,
verses.4:9: and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the lobe upon the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys,
verses.4:10: just as it is lifted off from the ox of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall offer them up in smoke upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.4:11: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, with its head and with its legs, its inward parts and its dung,
verses.4:12: the whole bull he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.
verses.4:13: Now if the whole congregation of Israel errs unintentionally, and the matter is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any one of all the commandments of the LORD which ought not to be done, and have become guilty;
verses.4:14: when the sin which they have sinned concerning it becomes known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the tent of meeting.
verses.4:15: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bull before the LORD, and the bull shall be slain before the LORD.
verses.4:16: Then the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the tent of meeting.
verses.4:17: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil.
verses.4:18: And some of the blood he shall put on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, which is in the tent of meeting; and all the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.4:19: And he shall lift off all its fat from it and offer it up in smoke upon the altar.
verses.4:20: Thus he shall do with the bull; just as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so shall he do with this one. And the priest shall make atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.4:21: Then he shall carry the bull outside the camp and burn it just as he burned the first bull; it is a sin offering for the assembly.
verses.4:22: When a ruler sins, and does unintentionally any one of all the commandments of the LORD his God which ought not to be done, and becomes guilty,
verses.4:23: or if his sin which he has committed is made known to him, then he shall bring as his offering a male goat without blemish.
verses.4:24: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat and slay it in the place where they slay the burnt offering before the LORD; it is a sin offering.
verses.4:25: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.4:26: And all its fat he shall offer up in smoke upon the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; so the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.4:27: Now if any one person of the people of the land sins unintentionally by doing one of the commandments of the LORD which ought not to be done, and becomes guilty,
verses.4:28: or if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring as his offering a female goat without blemish for his sin which he has sinned.
verses.4:29: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.4:30: Then the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out all its blood at the base of the altar.
verses.4:31: And he shall remove all its fat, just as fat is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall offer it up in smoke upon the altar for a soothing aroma to the LORD. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.4:32: And if he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.4:33: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they slay the burnt offering.
verses.4:34: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out all its blood at the base of the altar.
verses.4:35: And he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall offer them up in smoke upon the altar, upon the offerings made by fire to the LORD. Thus the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin which he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.'"
verses.5:1: "And if a person sins in hearing the voice of a solemn adjuration, and he is a witness, whether he has seen or known of the matter—if he does not tell it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.5:2: Or if a person touches any unclean thing, whether the carcass of an unclean wild beast, or the carcass of an unclean domestic animal, or the carcass of an unclean creeping thing, and it is hidden from him, yet he is unclean, then he becomes guilty.
verses.5:3: Or if he touches human uncleanness, whatever his uncleanness may be by which a person becomes unclean, and it is hidden from him—when he comes to know it, then he becomes guilty.
verses.5:4: Or if a person swears, speaking rashly with the lips to do evil or to do good, whatever a man may speak rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he comes to know it, then he shall be guilty in any one of these matters.
verses.5:5: And it shall be, when he is guilty in any one of these matters, that he shall confess that which he has sinned concerning it,
verses.5:6: and he shall bring his guilt offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a female goat, as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.
verses.5:7: And if his means are not sufficient for a lamb, then he shall bring to the LORD, as his guilt offering for that which he has sinned, two turtledoves or two young pigeons: one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.
verses.5:8: And he shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer first that which is for the sin offering, and pinch its head at the back of its neck, yet shall not sever it completely.
verses.5:9: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar, and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin offering.
verses.5:10: And the second he shall prepare as a burnt offering according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.5:11: But if his means cannot reach two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he who has sinned shall bring as his offering one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, nor shall he place frankincense upon it, for it is a sin offering.
verses.5:12: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as its memorial portion and offer it up in smoke upon the altar, upon the offerings made by fire to the LORD; it is a sin offering.
verses.5:13: Thus the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin which he has sinned in any one of these matters, and it shall be forgiven him; and it shall belong to the priest, like the grain offering."
verses.5:14: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:15: "If a person commits a trespass and sins unintentionally regarding the holy things of the LORD, then he shall bring to the LORD as his guilt offering a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your valuation in shekels of silver, by the shekel of the sanctuary, for a guilt offering.
verses.5:16: And he shall make restitution for that in which he has sinned regarding the holy thing, and shall add one-fifth to it and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.5:17: And if a person sins and does any one of all the commandments of the LORD which ought not to be done, though he does not know it, yet he is guilty and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.5:18: And he shall bring to the priest a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your valuation, as a guilt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his unintentional error in which he erred, though he did not know it, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.5:19: It is a guilt offering; he has surely incurred guilt before the LORD."
verses.5:20: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:21: "If a person sins and commits a trespass against the LORD, and deals falsely with his neighbor concerning a deposit, or a pledge placed in his hand, or robbery, or has extorted from his neighbor,
verses.5:22: or has found what was lost and dealt falsely concerning it, and sworn falsely—in any one of all the things that a man may do to sin in them:
verses.5:23: then it shall be, because he has sinned and incurred guilt, that he shall restore what he took by robbery, or what he gained by extortion, or the deposit which was entrusted to him, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.5:24: or anything about which he has sworn falsely; he shall restore it in full, and shall add one-fifth more to it, and give it to the one to whom it belongs on the day of his guilt offering.
verses.5:25: And he shall bring his guilt offering to the LORD, a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your valuation, as a guilt offering, to the priest.
verses.5:26: And the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and it shall be forgiven him for any one of all the things he may have done to incur guilt in it."
verses.6:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:2: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the burnt offering: The burnt offering shall remain on the hearth upon the altar all night until the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
verses.6:3: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put linen undergarments over his flesh, and take up the ashes of the burnt offering which the fire has consumed on the altar, and place them beside the altar.
verses.6:4: Then he shall take off his garments, put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
verses.6:5: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not go out. And the priest shall burn wood on it morning by morning, and arrange the burnt offering in order on it, and burn on it the fat portions of the peace offerings.
verses.6:6: A continual fire shall be kept burning upon the altar; it shall not go out.
verses.6:7: Now this is the law of the grain offering: The sons of Aaron shall present it before the LORD, in front of the altar.
verses.6:8: And one shall take up from it a handful of the fine flour of the grain offering and of its oil, together with all the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and burn it on the altar for a sweet aroma, as its memorial portion to the LORD.
verses.6:9: And the remainder of it Aaron and his sons shall eat; it shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place; they shall eat it in the court of the tent of meeting.
verses.6:10: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their portion from My offerings made by fire; it is most holy, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.
verses.6:11: Every male among the sons of Aaron may eat it. It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations from the offerings made by fire to the LORD. Whatever touches them shall become holy.'"
verses.6:12: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:13: "This is the offering of Aaron and his sons, which they shall present to the LORD on the day when he is anointed: one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a continual grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.
verses.6:14: It shall be prepared on a griddle with oil; well-mixed you shall bring it. You shall present the baked pieces of the grain offering in broken fragments as a sweet aroma to the LORD.
verses.6:15: And the priest from among his sons who is anointed in his place shall prepare it. It is a perpetual statute to the LORD; it shall be wholly burned.
verses.6:16: For every grain offering of a priest shall be wholly burned; it shall not be eaten."
verses.6:17: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:18: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the sin offering shall be slaughtered before the LORD. It is most holy.
verses.6:19: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the tent of meeting.
verses.6:20: Whatever touches its flesh shall become holy. And if any of its blood is spattered upon a garment, you shall wash what it was spattered upon in a holy place.
verses.6:21: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be both scoured and rinsed with water.
verses.6:22: Every male among the priests may eat it; it is most holy.
verses.6:23: Yet no sin offering from which any of the blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place shall be eaten; it shall be burned with fire.'"
verses.7:1: Now this is the law of the guilt offering: It is most holy.
verses.7:2: In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering, they shall slaughter the guilt offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle all around upon the altar.
verses.7:3: And he shall offer all its fat from it: the fat tail and the fat that covers the inward parts,
verses.7:4: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the loins, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.
verses.7:5: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar as an offering made by fire to the LORD; it is a guilt offering.
verses.7:6: Every male among the priests may eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.
verses.7:7: As the sin offering is, so is the guilt offering; there is one law for them: the priest who makes atonement with it shall have it.
verses.7:8: And the priest who offers any man's burnt offering, that priest shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
verses.7:9: Also every grain offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in a covered pan or on a griddle, shall belong to the priest who offers it.
verses.7:10: And every grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, one as much as another.
verses.7:11: Now this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which one shall offer to the LORD:
verses.7:12: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes of well-mixed fine flour mingled with oil.
verses.7:13: With cakes of leavened bread he shall present his offering, together with the thanksgiving sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.7:14: And from it he shall present one out of each offering as a heave offering to the LORD; it shall belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.7:15: And the flesh of the thanksgiving sacrifice of his peace offerings shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.7:16: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice; and on the next day also the remainder of it may be eaten.
verses.7:17: Yet the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
verses.7:18: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, nor shall it be credited to him who offers it; it shall be an abomination, and the person who eats of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.7:19: Moreover, the flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burned with fire. And as for the flesh, every clean person may eat the flesh.
verses.7:20: But the person who eats flesh from the sacrifice of the peace offerings that belong to the LORD, while his uncleanness is upon him, that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.7:21: Moreover, if a person touches any unclean thing, whether human uncleanness, or an unclean beast, or any unclean detestable thing, and eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belong to the LORD, that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.7:22: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:23: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'You shall not eat any fat, of ox or sheep or goat.
verses.7:24: And the fat of an animal that dies naturally, and the fat of what is torn by wild beasts, may be used for any other purpose; but you shall by no means eat it.
verses.7:25: For whoever eats the fat of the animal from which an offering made by fire is presented to the LORD, the person who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.7:26: Furthermore, you shall not eat any blood in any of your dwellings, whether of bird or of beast.
verses.7:27: Any person who eats any blood, that person shall be cut off from his people.'"
verses.7:28: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:29: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD from the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.7:30: His own hands shall bring the offerings made by fire to the LORD; the fat with the breast he shall bring, that the breast may be waved as a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.7:31: And the priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall belong to Aaron and his sons.
verses.7:32: Also the right thigh you shall give to the priest as a heave offering from the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.7:33: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings and the fat shall have the right thigh as his portion.
verses.7:34: For the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering I have taken from the children of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as a perpetual statute from the children of Israel.'"
verses.7:35: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron and the consecrated portion of his sons from the offerings made by fire to the LORD, on the day He presented them to minister as priests to the LORD,
verses.7:36: which the LORD commanded to be given to them from the children of Israel on the day He anointed them, as a perpetual statute throughout their generations.
verses.7:37: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the grain offering, of the sin offering, of the guilt offering, of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings,
verses.7:38: which the LORD commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day He commanded the children of Israel to present their offerings to the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.8:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:2: "Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull for the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
verses.8:3: and assemble all the congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting."
verses.8:4: So Moses did just as the LORD commanded him, and the congregation assembled at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.8:5: And Moses said to the congregation, "This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done."
verses.8:6: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.
verses.8:7: He put the tunic on him, girded him with the sash, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him; and he girded him with the woven band of the ephod, and fastened the ephod upon him with it.
verses.8:8: Then he placed the breastplate on him, and into the breastplate he put the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.8:9: And he set the turban upon his head; and upon the turban, at the front of it, he set the golden plate, the holy crown, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:10: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and consecrated them.
verses.8:11: He sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the laver and its base, to consecrate them.
verses.8:12: And he poured some of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head and anointed him, to consecrate him.
verses.8:13: Then Moses brought Aaron's sons forward and clothed them with tunics, and girded them with sashes, and bound caps upon them, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:14: And he brought forward the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bull for the sin offering.
verses.8:15: And he slaughtered it, and Moses took the blood and put it on the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar; and the rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar, and consecrated it to make atonement for it.
verses.8:16: Then he took all the fat that was on the entrails, and the fatty lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses burned them upon the altar.
verses.8:17: But the bull, its hide, its flesh, and its offal he burned with fire outside the camp, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:18: Then he brought forward the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.8:19: And he slaughtered it, and Moses dashed the blood against the altar all around.
verses.8:20: Then he cut the ram into its pieces, and Moses burned the head, the pieces, and the suet.
verses.8:21: And he washed the entrails and the legs with water, and Moses burned the entire ram upon the altar; it was a burnt offering for a soothing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:22: Then he brought forward the second ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.8:23: And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.8:24: Then he brought Aaron's sons forward, and Moses put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet; and Moses dashed the blood against the altar all around.
verses.8:25: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was on the entrails, and the fatty lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh.
verses.8:26: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer, and placed them upon the fat portions and upon the right thigh.
verses.8:27: Then he placed all these upon the palms of Aaron and upon the palms of his sons, and waved them as a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.8:28: Then Moses took them from their palms and burned them upon the altar on top of the burnt offering; they were an ordination offering for a soothing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
verses.8:29: And Moses took the breast and waved it as a wave offering before the LORD; from the ram of ordination it was Moses' portion, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:30: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him; and he consecrated Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
verses.8:31: And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, "Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and there you shall eat it along with the bread that is in the basket of ordination, just as I have commanded, saying, 'Aaron and his sons shall eat it.'
verses.8:32: And whatever remains of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
verses.8:33: And you shall not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the day when the days of your ordination are fulfilled; for seven days it shall take to ordain you.
verses.8:34: As has been done this day, so the LORD has commanded to be done, to make atonement for you.
verses.8:35: Therefore you shall abide at the entrance of the tent of meeting day and night for seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, so that you may not die; for thus I have been commanded."
verses.8:36: So Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD had commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.9:1: Now it came to pass on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
verses.9:2: And he said to Aaron, "Take for yourself a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
verses.9:3: And to the children of Israel you shall speak, saying, 'Take a male goat for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
verses.9:4: also an ox and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil; for today the LORD will appear to you.'"
verses.9:5: So they brought what Moses had commanded before the tent of meeting, and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
verses.9:6: Then Moses said, "This is the thing which the LORD has commanded that you should do, and the glory of the LORD shall appear to you."
verses.9:7: And Moses said to Aaron, "Draw near to the altar, offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, just as the LORD has commanded."
verses.9:8: So Aaron drew near to the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering which was for himself.
verses.9:9: Then the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.9:10: But the fat, the kidneys, and the fatty lobe from the liver of the sin offering he burned upon the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.9:11: And the flesh and the hide he burned with fire outside the camp.
verses.9:12: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering, and Aaron's sons presented the blood to him, and he dashed it against the altar all around.
verses.9:13: And they presented the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, along with the head, and he burned them upon the altar.
verses.9:14: And he washed the entrails and the legs, and burned them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.9:15: Then he brought forward the people's offering, and took the male goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and slaughtered it and offered it for sin, like the first.
verses.9:16: And he brought forward the burnt offering and offered it according to the ordinance.
verses.9:17: Then he brought forward the grain offering, filled his palm from it, and burned it upon the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.
verses.9:18: He also slaughtered the ox and the ram as the sacrifice of peace offerings which was for the people; and Aaron's sons presented the blood to him, and he dashed it against the altar all around.
verses.9:19: As for the fat portions from the ox and from the ram—the fat tail, the covering fat, the kidneys, and the fatty lobe of the liver—
verses.9:20: they placed the fat portions upon the breasts, and he burned the fat portions upon the altar.
verses.9:21: And the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved as a wave offering before the LORD, just as Moses had commanded.
verses.9:22: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and came down from offering the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
verses.9:23: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and came out and blessed the people; and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
verses.9:24: And fire came forth from before the LORD and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat portions; and when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell upon their faces.
verses.10:1: Then the sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, each took his censer, put fire in it, laid incense upon it, and presented strange fire before the LORD, which He had not commanded them.
verses.10:2: So fire went forth from before the LORD and consumed them, and they died before the LORD.
verses.10:3: Then Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the LORD spoke, saying: 'Among those who draw near to Me I will be sanctified, and before all the people I will be glorified.'" And Aaron remained silent.
verses.10:4: Then Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, "Draw near, carry your brethren away from before the sanctuary to outside the camp."
verses.10:5: So they drew near and carried them in their tunics outside the camp, just as Moses had spoken.
verses.10:6: Then Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons, "Do not let the hair of your heads hang loose, nor tear your garments, lest you die and He be wrathful against all the congregation. Rather, let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled.
verses.10:7: And you shall not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting, lest you die, for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you." And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.10:8: Then the LORD spoke to Aaron, saying:
verses.10:9: "Do not drink wine or strong drink, neither you nor your sons with you, when you go into the tent of meeting, lest you die; it shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations,
verses.10:10: that you may distinguish between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean,
verses.10:11: and that you may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by the hand of Moses."
verses.10:12: Then Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his remaining sons: "Take the grain offering that remains from the offerings made by fire to the LORD, and eat it unleavened beside the altar, for it is most holy.
verses.10:13: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your due portion and the portion of your sons from the offerings made by fire to the LORD; for thus I have been commanded.
verses.10:14: And the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons and your daughters with you; for they are given as your due portion and the portion of your sons from the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.10:15: The thigh of the heave offering and the breast of the wave offering they shall bring along with the fire offerings of the fat portions, to wave as a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall belong to you and to your sons with you as a perpetual due, just as the LORD has commanded."
verses.10:16: Then Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it had been burned up! So he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the remaining sons of Aaron, saying:
verses.10:17: "Why have you not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing that it is most holy, and He has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
verses.10:18: Behold, its blood was not brought inside the holy place; you certainly should have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded."
verses.10:19: Then Aaron spoke to Moses, "Behold, this very day they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD, and such things as these have befallen me! If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the sight of the LORD?"
verses.10:20: And Moses heard it, and it was pleasing in his sight.
verses.11:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying to them:
verses.11:2: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: 'These are the living creatures which you may eat among all the beasts that are upon the earth.
verses.11:3: Whatever parts the hoof, having cloven hooves and chewing the cud, among the beasts—that you may eat.
verses.11:4: Nevertheless, these you shall not eat among those that chew the cud or those that part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud, yet does not part the hoof; it is unclean to you;
verses.11:5: and the hare, because it chews the cud, yet does not part the hoof; it is unclean to you;
verses.11:6: and the rock badger, because it chews the cud, yet does not part the hoof; it is unclean to you;
verses.11:7: and the swine, because it parts the hoof and has cloven hooves, yet does not chew the cud; it is unclean to you.
verses.11:8: Of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch; they are unclean to you.
verses.11:9: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas or in the streams—those you may eat.
verses.11:10: But whatever does not have fins and scales in the seas and in the streams, of all the swarming things in the waters and of every living creature that is in the waters, they are detestable to you.
verses.11:11: They shall remain detestable to you; of their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall detest.
verses.11:12: Whatever does not have fins and scales in the waters is detestable to you.
verses.11:13: And these you shall detest among the birds; they shall not be eaten, for they are detestable: the eagle, the bearded vulture, and the black vulture;
verses.11:14: the kite, and the falcon according to its kind;
verses.11:15: every raven according to its kind;
verses.11:16: the ostrich, the nighthawk, the seagull, and the hawk according to its kind;
verses.11:17: the little owl, the cormorant, and the great owl;
verses.11:18: the barn owl, the desert owl, and the carrion vulture;
verses.11:19: the stork, the heron according to its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.11:20: Every winged swarming creature that walks on all fours is detestable to you.
verses.11:21: Yet these you may eat among all the winged swarming creatures that walk on all fours: those that have jointed legs above their feet with which to leap upon the earth.
verses.11:22: These of them you may eat: the locust according to its kind, the bald locust according to its kind, the cricket according to its kind, and the grasshopper according to its kind.
verses.11:23: But every other winged swarming creature that has four feet is detestable to you.
verses.11:24: And by these you shall become unclean: whoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean until the evening,
verses.11:25: and whoever carries any part of their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until the evening.
verses.11:26: As for every beast that parts the hoof, yet is not cloven-footed and does not chew the cud, they are unclean to you; everyone who touches them shall be unclean.
verses.11:27: And whatever walks on its paws, among all the living creatures that walk on all fours, they are unclean to you; whoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.11:28: And he who carries their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until the evening; they are unclean to you.
verses.11:29: And these shall be unclean to you among the swarming creatures that swarm upon the earth: the mole rat, the mouse, and the great lizard according to its kind;
verses.11:30: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.
verses.11:31: These are the ones that are unclean to you among all the swarming creatures; whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.11:32: And anything upon which any of them falls when they are dead shall be unclean, whether it is any article of wood, or garment, or skin, or sackcloth—any article with which work is done—it shall be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening; then it shall be clean.
verses.11:33: And every earthen vessel into which any of them falls—whatever is in it shall be unclean, and you shall break it.
verses.11:34: Any food that may be eaten, upon which water comes, shall be unclean, and any drink that may be drunk in any vessel shall be unclean.
verses.11:35: And everything upon which any part of their carcasses falls shall be unclean; whether an oven or a hearth for pots, it shall be broken down; they are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.
verses.11:36: Nevertheless, a spring or a cistern containing a gathering of water shall be clean, yet whoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean.
verses.11:37: And if any part of their carcasses falls upon any sowing seed that is to be sown, it is clean.
verses.11:38: But if water is put upon the seed, and any part of their carcasses falls upon it, it is unclean to you.
verses.11:39: And if any beast dies which is yours for food, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.11:40: And he who eats of its carcass shall wash his garments and be unclean until the evening; and he who carries its carcass shall wash his garments and be unclean until the evening.
verses.11:41: And every swarming creature that swarms upon the earth is detestable; it shall not be eaten.
verses.11:42: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever walks on all fours, or whatever has many feet among all the swarming creatures that swarm upon the earth—you shall not eat them, for they are detestable.
verses.11:43: Do not make yourselves detestable with any swarming creature that swarms, nor shall you make yourselves unclean with them, lest you be defiled by them.
verses.11:44: For I am the LORD your God. You shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and you shall be holy, for I am holy; neither shall you defile yourselves with any swarming creature that creeps upon the earth.
verses.11:45: For I am the LORD who brings you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God; you shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.'"
verses.11:46: This is the law of the beasts and the birds and every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that swarms upon the earth,
verses.11:47: to distinguish between the unclean and the clean, and between the living creature that may be eaten and the living creature that may not be eaten.
verses.12:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.12:2: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying, 'When a woman conceives and gives birth to a male child, she shall be unclean for seven days; as in the days of the separation for her monthly infirmity, she shall be unclean.
verses.12:3: Then on the eighth day, the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.12:4: And for thirty-three days she shall remain in the blood of purification; she shall not touch any holy thing, nor enter the sanctuary, until the days of her purification are completed.
verses.12:5: But if she gives birth to a female child, she shall be unclean for two weeks, as in her menstrual separation; and for sixty-six days she shall remain in the blood of purification.
verses.12:6: And when the days of her purification are completed, whether for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb in its first year as a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin offering, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, to the priest.
verses.12:7: And he shall present it before the LORD and make atonement for her, and she shall be clean from the flow of her blood. This is the law for her who gives birth, whether to a male or to a female.
verses.12:8: And if her means are not sufficient for a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one as a burnt offering and one as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.'"
verses.13:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:
verses.13:2: "When a man has on the skin of his flesh a swelling, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes on the skin of his flesh a plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest, or to one of his sons the priests.
verses.13:3: And the priest shall examine the plague on the skin of the flesh; and if the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy. Then the priest shall look upon him and declare him unclean.
verses.13:4: But if the bright spot is white on the skin of his flesh, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and its hair has not turned white, then the priest shall confine the one who has the plague for seven days.
verses.13:5: And the priest shall examine him on the seventh day; and behold, if the plague has remained unchanged in his sight, and the plague has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall confine him for another seven days.
verses.13:6: Then the priest shall examine him a second time on the seventh day; and behold, if the plague has faded, and the plague has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall declare him clean; it is a scab. And he shall wash his garments and be clean.
verses.13:7: But if the scab spreads further on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself a second time to the priest.
verses.13:8: And the priest shall examine him, and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.13:9: When a plague of leprosy is on a man, then he shall be brought to the priest.
verses.13:10: And the priest shall examine him, and behold, there is a white swelling on the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is a patch of raw flesh in the swelling.
verses.13:11: It is a chronic leprosy on the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall declare him unclean; he shall not confine him, for he is unclean.
verses.13:12: And if the leprosy breaks out extensively on the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the one who has the plague, from his head to his feet, as far as the eyes of the priest can see,
verses.13:13: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall declare the one who has the plague clean. It has all turned white; he is clean.
verses.13:14: But on the day raw flesh appears on him, he shall be unclean.
verses.13:15: And the priest shall examine the raw flesh and declare him unclean; the raw flesh is unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.13:16: Or if the raw flesh changes again and turns white, then he shall come to the priest.
verses.13:17: And the priest shall examine him, and behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall declare the one who has the plague clean; he is clean.
verses.13:18: And when the body has a boil on its skin, and it is healed,
verses.13:19: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling or a reddish-white bright spot, then it shall be shown to the priest.
verses.13:20: And the priest shall examine it, and behold, if its appearance is lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a plague of leprosy; it has broken out in the boil.
verses.13:21: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin, and it has faded, then the priest shall confine him for seven days.
verses.13:22: And if it spreads further on the skin, then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a plague.
verses.13:23: But if the bright spot remains in its place and has not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall declare him clean.
verses.13:24: Or when the body has a burn by fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white or white,
verses.13:25: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy; it has broken out in the burn. Therefore the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a plague of leprosy.
verses.13:26: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it is not lower than the skin, and it has faded, then the priest shall confine him for seven days.
verses.13:27: And the priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it spreads further on the skin, then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a plague of leprosy.
verses.13:28: But if the bright spot remains in its place, and has not spread on the skin, and it has faded, it is a swelling from the burn; and the priest shall declare him clean, for it is the scar of the burn.
verses.13:29: And when a man or a woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,
verses.13:30: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and there is thin yellow hair in it, then the priest shall declare him unclean. It is a scaly eruption; it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.
verses.13:31: And when the priest examines the plague of the scaly eruption, and behold, its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall confine the one who has the plague of the scaly eruption for seven days.
verses.13:32: And the priest shall examine the plague on the seventh day; and behold, if the scaly eruption has not spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the scaly eruption is not deeper than the skin,
verses.13:33: then he shall shave himself, but he shall not shave the scaly eruption; and the priest shall confine the one who has the scaly eruption for another seven days.
verses.13:34: And the priest shall examine the scaly eruption on the seventh day; and behold, if the scaly eruption has not spread on the skin, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, then the priest shall declare him clean. And he shall wash his garments and be clean.
verses.13:35: But if the scaly eruption spreads further on the skin after his cleansing,
verses.13:36: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scaly eruption has spread on the skin, the priest need not search for yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.13:37: But if the scaly eruption has remained unchanged in his sight, and black hair has grown in it, the scaly eruption is healed; he is clean, and the priest shall declare him clean.
verses.13:38: And when a man or a woman has bright spots on the skin of their flesh, white bright spots,
verses.13:39: then the priest shall examine them; and behold, if on the skin of their flesh there are dull white bright spots, it is a white rash that has broken out on the skin; he is clean.
verses.13:40: And when a man loses the hair of his head, he is bald; he is clean.
verses.13:41: And if he loses the hair from the front of his head, he has a bald forehead; he is clean.
verses.13:42: But if there is on the bald head or on the bald forehead a reddish-white plague, it is leprosy breaking out on his bald head or on his bald forehead.
verses.13:43: Then the priest shall examine him; and behold, the swelling of the plague is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy on the skin of the flesh.
verses.13:44: He is a leprous man; he is unclean. The priest shall surely declare him unclean; his plague is on his head.
verses.13:45: And as for the leper in whom the plague is, his garments shall be torn and his head shall be left unkempt, and he shall cover his upper lip, and cry out, 'Unclean! Unclean!'
verses.13:46: All the days that the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean; he shall dwell alone; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.
verses.13:47: Also, when a garment has a plague of leprosy in it, whether in a garment of wool or in a garment of linen,
verses.13:48: whether in the warp or in the woof of linen or of wool, or in leather, or in anything made of leather,
verses.13:49: and if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment or in the leather, or in the warp or in the woof, or in any article of leather, it is a plague of leprosy, and it shall be shown to the priest.
verses.13:50: And the priest shall examine the plague, and confine that which has the plague for seven days.
verses.13:51: And he shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in the leather, for whatever use the leather is made, the plague is a destructive leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.13:52: Therefore he shall burn the garment, or the warp or the woof, whether of wool or of linen, or any article of leather in which the plague is; for it is a destructive leprosy; it shall be burned in the fire.
verses.13:53: But if the priest examines it, and behold, the plague has not spread in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any article of leather,
verses.13:54: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing in which the plague is, and he shall confine it for another seven days.
verses.13:55: And the priest shall examine the plague after it has been washed; and behold, if the plague has not changed its appearance, even though the plague has not spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a corrosion, whether on its back side or on its front side.
verses.13:56: And if the priest examines it, and behold, the plague has faded after it has been washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the leather, or out of the warp, or out of the woof.
verses.13:57: And if it appears again in the garment, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any article of leather, it is breaking out; you shall burn in the fire that in which the plague is.
verses.13:58: But as for the garment, or the warp, or the woof, or any article of leather which you wash, if the plague departs from them, then it shall be washed a second time, and it shall be clean.
verses.13:59: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of wool or of linen, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in any article of leather, to declare it clean or to declare it unclean."
verses.14:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.14:2: "This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought to the priest.
verses.14:3: And the priest shall go outside the camp, and the priest shall look; and behold, if the plague of leprosy has been healed in the leper,
verses.14:4: then the priest shall command to take for the one to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop.
verses.14:5: And the priest shall command to slaughter the one bird in an earthen vessel over running water.
verses.14:6: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet yarn, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the running water.
verses.14:7: And he shall sprinkle seven times upon the one to be cleansed from the leprosy, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go free into the open field.
verses.14:8: Then the one to be cleansed shall wash his garments, shave off all his hair, and bathe in water, and he shall be clean; and afterward he may enter the camp, yet he shall dwell outside his tent seven days.
verses.14:9: And it shall be on the seventh day that he shall shave off all his hair—his head, his beard, and his eyebrows, indeed all his hair he shall shave off; and he shall wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.14:10: And on the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.14:11: Then the priest who performs the cleansing shall present the man who is to be cleansed, together with those things, before the LORD at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.14:12: And the priest shall take the one male lamb and offer it as a trespass offering, along with the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.14:13: Then he shall slaughter the male lamb in the place where he slaughters the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place; for like the sin offering, the trespass offering belongs to the priest. It is most holy.
verses.14:14: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.14:15: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
verses.14:16: Then the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left palm, and with his finger he shall sprinkle some of the oil seven times before the LORD.
verses.14:17: And of the remainder of the oil that is in his palm, the priest shall put some upon the tip of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, over the blood of the trespass offering.
verses.14:18: And what remains of the oil that is in the palm of the priest he shall put upon the head of the one to be cleansed; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.14:19: Then the priest shall offer the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall slaughter the burnt offering.
verses.14:20: And the priest shall offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering upon the altar; thus the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.14:21: Yet if he is poor and cannot afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb as a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil as a grain offering, and a log of oil,
verses.14:22: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, such as he can afford; and one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.14:23: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing to the priest, to the doorway of the tent of meeting, before the LORD.
verses.14:24: Then the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.14:25: And he shall slaughter the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it upon the tip of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.14:26: And the priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand.
verses.14:27: Then the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left palm seven times before the LORD.
verses.14:28: And the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his palm upon the tip of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering.
verses.14:29: And what remains of the oil that is in the palm of the priest he shall put upon the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.14:30: And he shall offer one of the turtledoves or of the young pigeons, such as he can afford,
verses.14:31: even such as he is able to afford, the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering; and the priest shall make atonement for the one to be cleansed before the LORD.
verses.14:32: This is the law for him who has a plague of leprosy, who cannot afford what pertains to his cleansing."
verses.14:33: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.14:34: "When you enter the land of Canaan, which I give to you as a possession, and I put a plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession,
verses.14:35: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, 'Something like a plague has appeared to me in the house.'
verses.14:36: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house before the priest goes in to examine the plague, so that all that is in the house may not become unclean; and afterward the priest shall go in to examine the house.
verses.14:37: And he shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with greenish or reddish depressions, and their appearance is deeper than the wall,
verses.14:38: then the priest shall go out of the house to the doorway of the house and shut up the house seven days.
verses.14:39: And the priest shall return on the seventh day and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the walls of the house,
verses.14:40: then the priest shall command that they pull out the stones in which the plague is, and cast them outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.14:41: And he shall have the house scraped inside all around, and they shall pour out the plaster that they scrape off outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.14:42: Then they shall take other stones and put them in the place of those stones, and he shall take other mortar and plaster the house.
verses.14:43: Now if the plague returns and breaks out in the house after the stones have been pulled out, after the house has been scraped, and after it has been plastered,
verses.14:44: then the priest shall come and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a malignant leprosy in the house. It is unclean.
verses.14:45: And he shall tear down the house—its stones, its timber, and all the plaster of the house—and carry them outside the city to an unclean place.
verses.14:46: Moreover, whoever enters the house during all the days that he has shut it up shall be unclean until the evening.
verses.14:47: And he who lies down in the house shall wash his garments, and he who eats in the house shall wash his garments.
verses.14:48: But if the priest indeed comes in and looks, and behold, the plague has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
verses.14:49: And to cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop.
verses.14:50: And he shall slaughter the one bird in an earthen vessel over running water.
verses.14:51: Then he shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
verses.14:52: Thus he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet yarn.
verses.14:53: Then he shall let the living bird go free outside the city into the open field, and make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.
verses.14:54: This is the law for every plague of leprosy and for a scale,
verses.14:55: for leprosy of a garment and of a house,
verses.14:56: for a swelling, for a scab, and for a bright spot,
verses.14:57: to teach when a thing is unclean and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy."
verses.15:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.15:2: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: 'When any man has a discharge from his flesh, his discharge is unclean.
verses.15:3: And this shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his flesh flows with his discharge, or his flesh is stopped up from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
verses.15:4: Every bed on which the one who has the discharge lies shall be unclean, and every article on which he sits shall be unclean.
verses.15:5: And anyone who touches his bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:6: And he who sits on the article on which the one with the discharge has sat shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:7: And he who touches the flesh of the one with the discharge shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:8: And if the one with the discharge spits on one who is clean, then he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:9: And every saddle on which the one with the discharge rides shall be unclean.
verses.15:10: And whoever touches anything that was beneath him shall be unclean until evening; and he who carries those things shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:11: And anyone whom the one with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:12: And an earthen vessel that the one with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every wooden vessel shall be rinsed in water.
verses.15:13: And when the one with the discharge is cleansed of his discharge, he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing, wash his garments, and bathe his flesh in running water; and he shall be clean.
verses.15:14: And on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and give them to the priest.
verses.15:15: And the priest shall offer them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD because of his discharge.
verses.15:16: And if a man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:17: And every garment and every piece of leather on which there is semen shall be washed with water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:18: Also, when a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both shall bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:19: And when a woman has a discharge, and the discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall remain in her menstrual impurity seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:20: And everything on which she lies during her menstrual impurity shall be unclean; and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
verses.15:21: And whoever touches her bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:22: And whoever touches any article on which she sits shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:23: And if anything is on the bed or on the article on which she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:24: And if a man indeed lies with her, so that her menstrual impurity comes upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
verses.15:25: And if a woman has a discharge of blood for many days outside the time of her menstrual impurity, or if it continues beyond her menstrual impurity, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her menstrual impurity; she is unclean.
verses.15:26: Every bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her like the bed of her menstrual impurity; and every article on which she sits shall be unclean, as with the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.
verses.15:27: And whoever touches those things shall be unclean; he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.15:28: But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count for herself seven days, and afterward she shall be clean.
verses.15:29: And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.15:30: And the priest shall offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the discharge of her uncleanness.'
verses.15:31: Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness when they defile My tabernacle which is in their midst.
verses.15:32: This is the law for him who has a discharge, and for him from whom an emission of semen goes out, by which he becomes unclean,
verses.15:33: and for her who is unwell in her menstrual impurity, and for anyone who has a discharge, whether male or female, and for a man who lies with an unclean woman."
verses.16:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before the LORD and died;
verses.16:2: and the LORD said to Moses, "Speak to Aaron your brother, that he not come at just any time into the Holy Place inside the veil, before the mercy seat which is upon the ark, lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud above the mercy seat.
verses.16:3: Thus Aaron shall enter the Holy Place: with a young bull from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.16:4: He shall put on a holy linen tunic, and linen trousers shall be upon his flesh; he shall gird himself with a linen sash, and be attired with a linen turban. These are holy garments; therefore he shall bathe his flesh in water and put them on.
verses.16:5: And from the congregation of the children of Israel he shall take two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.16:6: Then Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his household.
verses.16:7: He shall take the two goats and set them before the LORD at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.16:8: And Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD and the other lot for Azazel.
verses.16:9: And Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer it as a sin offering.
verses.16:10: But the goat on which the lot fell for Azazel shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement over it, and to send it away for Azazel into the wilderness.
verses.16:11: And Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his household, and he shall slaughter the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.
verses.16:12: Then he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of finely beaten fragrant incense, and bring it inside the veil.
verses.16:13: And he shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat which is over the Testimony, lest he die.
verses.16:14: He shall take some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it with his finger on the front of the mercy seat toward the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.16:15: Then he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering which is for the people, bring its blood inside the veil, and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bull, sprinkling it upon the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.
verses.16:16: Thus he shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins; and so he shall do for the tent of meeting which dwells with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
verses.16:17: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out and has made atonement for himself, for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
verses.16:18: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it; and he shall take some of the blood of the bull and some of the blood of the goat, and put it on the horns of the altar all around.
verses.16:19: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.
verses.16:20: And when he has finished making atonement for the Holy Place, the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.
verses.16:21: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, confess over it all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them on the head of the goat, and shall send it away into the wilderness by the hand of an appointed man.
verses.16:22: And the goat shall bear upon itself all their iniquities to a solitary land; and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
verses.16:23: Then Aaron shall enter the tent of meeting, take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and leave them there.
verses.16:24: And he shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
verses.16:25: And the fat of the sin offering he shall burn upon the altar.
verses.16:26: And he who released the goat for Azazel shall wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.16:27: And the bull of the sin offering and the goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn with fire their hides, their flesh, and their dung.
verses.16:28: Then he who burns them shall wash his garments and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
